_comment: Data and files as applications sort, filter and read them: DataTable/DataView by Locale and CaseSensitive (kana and widths, Turkish I, German and Swedish letters), RowFilter, expressions and Compute over doubles, keys and Merge, a DataSet's XML; Directory.GetFiles' order and patterns (8.3 names), paths in another case, Windows paths, text in Shift_JIS, with a BOM, in UTF-16, the Japanese code pages' bytes. Each page writes 'case = value' lines.
